# V1.0.9

## New
- Navigate Backwards: Android back button and ESC key support across all screens, modals, and dialog boxes
- Carousel auto-start controls: "Start on app launch" and "Start on device boot" toggles in settings
- Enhanced multi-select: improved long-press detection, press animation, group selection handling
- Custom intent-based file picker replacing plyer: faster image import, parallel processing, and better Android 15 support
- Android 15 / API 35 permissions: `READ_MEDIA_VISUAL_USER_SELECTED` support for "allow limited access", rationale dialog, auto-redirect to app settings when permanently denied
- Export confirmation dialog before exporting wallpapers, no more accidental exports.
- Logs written to file immediately at app startup for easier debugging (at Android/data)
- Pick your Theme: choose Light, Dark, or Adaptive mode from Settings with real-time color updates throughout the app

## Fixes
- Numpad keyboard type for column number input
- URI permission handling improved for reliable image access from all sources
- Multi-select header no longer overlaps the scroll area
- Collapsed wallpaper groups no longer expand when changing columns
- Some apps could not recognizing shared images
- Share button no longer gets stuck on the preview screen
- Dialog boxes no longer let touches pass through in multi-select mode
- Light theme colors display correctly throughout the app
